identifier: precursors of the compounds in Table 1
notes: Caption-level generic reference to a set of whole molecules, the precursors of the Table 1 compounds; it points at compounds enumerated elsewhere and names no specific one, so it stays unresolved. The role follows the caption, which calls them Vorprodukte (precursors) of the Table 1 compounds. The table body enumerates rows 3a, 4a, 5a and 9a, each of which carries 1H NMR data and is emitted as its own record. The caption line is prefixed with a stray token None from the vision read.

Compound is defined by the Tabelle 1a caption plus row Nr. 3a; the row fixes R1 = OCH2CF3 and R7 = H. The caption fixes the rest of the scaffold by reference to Tabelle 1 and by a drawing, but the drawing on line 653 was read as an empty molecules list by the vision pass, so the scaffold is not available in this section and no systematic name could be constructed atom by atom. The row is emitted because its Physikalische Daten cell carries a full 1H NMR block, so the compound was actually made and characterised.
